comment: Canonical machine-path ban set for the public docs gates. scripts/check-docs.mjs and scripts/release-check.ps1 both read this file, so a durable doc cannot pass one gate and fail the other on the same path. Entries are regular-expression source text shared by the JavaScript and .NET engines; Select-String and RegExp are case-insensitive on these. The whole author-machine root C:\Inference is banned with no exceptions (FR-15, operator ruling 2026-11-06): the harness ships no default under it.
